title: Issue with nginx HTTP/2 Implementation
description: Multiple security issues affecting the nginx HTTP/2 implementation were disclosed in November 2026. AWS acknowledges these issues and recommends upgrading to nginx versions 1.30.7 (stable) or 1.31.9 (mainline) where the vulnerabilities have been addressed. AWS is also deploying mitigations globally. These vulnerabilities occur at the HTTP/2 protocol layer before a full HTTP request is formed, limiting the effectiveness of AWS WAF rules in detecting or blocking exploitation attempts.
